catalog_boundary.normalization: Clauses share one schema only when their carrier, selected mode, proof profile, predicate binding, assumptions, observation boundary, and failure ceiling support the same responsibility. Clause labels alone never establish equivalence.

assumption_sets.A-BUD: Natural or checked `u64` accounting; serialized atomic guard/update; complete writer inventory; no distributed, durable, or recovery claim.
assumption_sets.A-QH: Finite nodes; typed level/cost domains; atomic edge and parent commit; no connectivity, balancing, concurrency, or durability claim.
assumption_sets.A-RR: Typed keys/values; serialized atomic replace/remove; complete writer inventory; no authorization, versioning, durability, or distribution claim.
assumption_sets.A-CS: Finite candidates/seats, stable candidate order, bounded scores/weights, serialized mutation, and reset of dependent state after score change; no cross-mode equivalence or eventual selection.
assumption_sets.A-ACT: Fixed seat and target universes with guarded Allocate/Deallocate environment actions, atomic allocation-read/effect-record and finish check, serialized mutation; recorded effects do not prove an external side effect, exactly-once execution, durability, or recovery.
assumption_sets.A-PROP: Finite graph, typed `Combine`, serialized rounds; the liveness row additionally relies on weak fairness of round admission, every node update, and round closure; no deadline or universal convergence.
assumption_sets.A-CONV: Natural thresholds, positive window, bounded delta, exact post-slide average, serialized updates; no eventual or statistical convergence.
assumption_sets.A-AUDIT: Typed finite log and atomic append. Preimage uniqueness additionally assumes `HashCR`; the crate's modulo-100 operation intentionally collides. No tamper transition, persistent custody, freshness, durability, or recovery is modeled.
assumption_sets.A-BACK: Finite bounded tree, modulo-three mutation closure and inverse round trip, serialized path/ledger mutation; no leaf coverage, search order, or general graph completeness.
assumption_sets.A-ALLOC: Finite node/cost domains, serialized atomic membership-cost-budget commit; formula is an upper-bound relation, not exact conservation or durability.
assumption_sets.A-FED: Finite sub-pools, serialized atomic delegation/allocation, one master capacity; no independent-pool failure, reclamation, consensus, or partition-tolerance result.
assumption_sets.A-BISECT: Ordered monotone threshold domain, sufficient declared probe budget, serialized interval mutation; convergence additionally assumes weak-fair probing; no time bound or changing-predicate result.
assumption_sets.A-EQUIV: Finite elements, bounded successful union count, serialized parent/rank mutation; no path compression, runtime complexity, or concurrency result.
assumption_sets.A-RATE: Monotone bounded logical clock supplied by the caller, serialized atomic rollover/acquire; no wall-clock accuracy, distribution, throughput, or fairness claim.
assumption_sets.A-REDUCE: Immutable ordered source, closed operator, serialized prefix mutation; no eventual full consumption, reorder equivalence, parallel reduction, or unchecked-overflow transfer.
assumption_sets.A-GRAPH: Finite nodes and weights, serialized registry mutation and derived adjacency projection. Irreflexivity applies only to the selected profile; no reachability, acyclicity, reciprocity, concurrency, or durability claim.
assumption_sets.A-SAMPLE: Finite item universe, serialized support-check/selection, caller-supplied proposals; no randomness quality, frequency, or fairness result.
assumption_sets.A-SIGNAL: Finite values and fixed listeners, serialized value-change/listener-progress commits and their derived pending/notified observations; no eventual, exactly-once, durable, or distributed delivery.
assumption_sets.A-TRAV: Finite rooted star profile, fixed node cost, serialized atomic visit/admission/charge; no queue-drain liveness, general topology, or durability.
assumption_sets.A-SEQ: Positive finite step count, nonempty value domain, one visible logical active locus, complete serialized writer inventory; no scheduler fairness, deadline, nested noninterference, or durable history.
assumption_sets.A-FJ: Finite workers and values, serialized atomic worker/barrier/output transitions, complete writer inventory; no worker progress, noninterference, deadline, or durability.
assumption_sets.A-STEP: Fixed finite topology, valid distinct edges, serialized atomic predecessor-check/readiness commit, complete writer inventory; no acyclicity, scheduler fairness, completion, or time bound.
assumption_sets.A-STREAM: Three- or four-stage chain, positive finite queue capacity, bounded input and typed records, serialized atomic queue/counter mutation; no scheduler fairness, eventual drain, arbitrary topology, durability, or exactly-once delivery.
